premise.claim: No existing e2e case covers a client-less CacheRuntime topology (a CacheRuntimeClass whose topology declares only master and worker); the curvine case ships a client component, so the client-less path through cacheruntime-controller is currently untested. The path used to panic (#6157, fixed in base at d1ae1ace).
premise.evidence: On base, test/gha-e2e contains only alluxio/jindo/juicefs/curvine; curvine's cacheruntimeclass.yaml declares a client component (line 102). Panic fix d1ae1ace is an ancestor of the merge base. See results/go-unit.out and README.

integration.note: cross-checks the manifests/scripts against the Go constants and helm chart that produce/consume them; no cluster needed

findings.claim: cacheruntime-created ASTS/DaemonSet/Service carry cacheruntime.fluid.io/name and component-name (new GC selector bites) and do NOT carry fluid.io/managed-by (old curvine selector was vacuous)
reportSummary.sh emits exactly the CacheRuntimeReportSummary json keys and exits non-zero on an empty metrics response
the FailedMount grep in test.sh matches the real CSI error wording and does not bridge two unrelated event messages
manifest name/port/key wiring (svc-<runtime>-<comp>, <comp>-0.<svc>, PVC/PV names, timeout json tag, controller label/container, ports) matches the code base
custom-entrypoint.sh rejects the client role and bogus actions

liveNote: L3 (kind cluster e2e) is out of scope for this round per the debate setup (no KUBECONFIG). CI evidence instead: all five kind-e2e matrix jobs on PR head 8a12cfaa are green.
